# bionic-docs

> Read PDF and EPUB with bionic fixation. A document is opened on your machine, every PDF page is kept as it was printed, and the leading letters of every word are emphasized. No upload, no account, no remote code.

A Manifest V3 extension for Chrome, Edge and Firefox. A bundled PDF.js draws each PDF page to a canvas, so images, diagrams and colours stay, and lays a positioned text layer over it that gets the emphasis. Pages open fitted to the window and zoom from 50% to 300%. An EPUB is unzipped in memory, its chapters sanitized and reflowed, and its spine and table of contents read. Both paths end in the same fixation step, shared with the sibling extension Bionic Page.

## Page

Everything is on one page, with a section for each part:

- [The reader](https://srivtx.github.io/bionic-docs/#reader): the compiled algorithm running over the repository's own fixture text, with a contents list, page and chapter navigation, the five modes, an intensity slider, an on/off switch, and a box for your own text.
- [Before and after](https://srivtx.github.io/bionic-docs/#compare-section): the same paragraph with a divider you can drag or move with the arrow keys.
- [Features](https://srivtx.github.io/bionic-docs/#features): pages as printed, fit and zoom, EPUB reflow, the five modes, resume, and keyboard control.
- [Reading modes](https://srivtx.github.io/bionic-docs/#modes): Half, Classic, Vowel anchor, Low distraction and Custom rule, each rendered live.
- [How it works](https://srivtx.github.io/bionic-docs/#how): sniff the first bytes, parse on device, emphasize text nodes; plus the module map.
- [Privacy](https://srivtx.github.io/bionic-docs/#privacy): no server, one request for the document you opened, bundled parsers, and the anti-network test gate.
- [Limits](https://srivtx.github.io/bionic-docs/#limits): scanned PDFs, embedded fonts, transparency groups and Type 3 glyphs, and minimal EPUB styling.
- [Install](https://srivtx.github.io/bionic-docs/#install): build both targets from one source tree with Bun and load the unpacked extension.
- [FAQ](https://srivtx.github.io/bionic-docs/#faq): uploads, PDF fidelity, local files, offline use, the Firefox version floor, and affiliation.
